**RSM  – 5 MATERIALS × 32 RUNS × 3 REPLICATIONS**

This can be estimated based on surface response methodology Vs ANN possibility?

1\. Optimization of different parameters like Concentration, Time (min), pH,	Dosage (mg) for 5 different materials. 

2\. among 5 materials which is the best one in terms of ANOVA

3\. for each material what is the actual value and the predicted value of adsorption capacity

I quote some papers statistics and reference images

Comparison within the material ( conc v/s time, conc v/s pH, conc v/s dosage, time v/s pH, time v/s dosage,  pH v/s dosage ) total 6 which were listed in below study  

1. Nguyen, T.T.T., Hoang, D.Q., Nguyen, D.T.C. and Tran, T.V., 2023\. Adsorptive optimization of crystal violet dye using central composite rotatable design and response surface methodology: statistical analysis, kinetic and isotherm studies. *Arabian Journal for Science and Engineering*, *48*(7), pp.8835-8848.  
     
2. Kumari, S., Agarwal, S., Chowdhry, J., Sharma, P., Kumar, M., Kumar, A., Nayak, M. and Garg, M.C., 2026\. Comparative assessment of artificial neural network and response surface methodology for modeling and optimizing phosphate adsorption onto rice straw biochar. *Journal of Environmental Management*, *414*, p.130484.
